statutory.reasoning: § 5318(g) requires financial institutions to file a SAR when they know, suspect, or have reason to suspect suspicious activity. The fact pattern shows a business with 44 transactions and a declared monthly volume of $136,479, but provides no evidence of structuring, placement, or integration, nor does it identify the entity as a covered financial institution.
